description.value: Abandoned Rail Brewing Co. is a family-run estate brewery on the Naramata Bench where the owners farm their own barley to produce European-inspired, award-winning craft beers. The taproom sits alongside the Kettle Valley Rail Trail with sweeping bench views, explicitly positioned as a 20-minute bike ride from downtown Penticton and a natural trail stop. A kitchen serves pizza alongside an extensive tap list that includes a certified gluten-free sorghum-based pale ale, and a Guest House is available for overnight stays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible via cached content and confirms the brewery is open, operating at 1220 Davenport Ave in Penticton, matching the OSM address. The site explicitly markets the taproom as '20 minute bike ride from downtown Penticton' alongside the Kettle Valley Rail Trail, confirming strong cyclist relevance; dog-friendly patios and a kitchen serving pizza alongside craft beer are described. Beer sold in 4-packs confirms takeout capability, and a certified gluten-free sorghum-based pale ale (tested below 20ppm) is documented on the website; no explicit bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere in the site content.
